title: Conditions of Appraisal, Revision and Dispute on Northbeam Renew Trade-In
content:
The days Northbeam Renew Trade-In may take over an appraisal, the shortfall it will bear before the customer must be asked again, the notice a revised offer must be put within, the days the customer has to answer it, whether silence answers it, the days a dispute may be brought within and whether photographs are kept are all conditions of the Renew programme the agreement is written under.

1. **Days the appraisal may take.** Renew Instant Store Quote, 0; Renew Mail In Appraisal, 5; Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month, 3; Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month, 3; Renew Business Asset Buyback, 7; Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement, 14.
2. **Percentage the appraisal may fall below the quote before the customer must be asked again.** Renew Instant Store Quote, 0; Renew Mail In Appraisal, 10; Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month, 5; Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month, 5; Renew Business Asset Buyback, 10; Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement, 15.
3. **Days within which a revised offer must be put to the customer.** Renew Instant Store Quote, 0; Renew Mail In Appraisal, 2; both trade-up programmes, 2; Renew Business Asset Buyback, 3; Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement, 5.
4. **Days the customer has to answer a revised offer.** Renew Instant Store Quote, 0; Renew Mail In Appraisal, 7; both trade-up programmes, 10; Renew Business Asset Buyback, 14; Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement, 21.
5. **Whether silence past those days is taken as acceptance.** Taken as acceptance on Renew Mail In Appraisal, Renew Business Asset Buyback and Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement; not taken as acceptance on Renew Instant Store Quote, Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month or Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month.
6. **Days after the credit is issued within which the appraisal may be disputed.** Renew Instant Store Quote, 7; Renew Mail In Appraisal, 30; both trade-up programmes, 30; Renew Business Asset Buyback, 30; Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement, 45.
7. **Whether photographs of the appraised device are kept on file.** Kept on every programme except Renew Instant Store Quote.

The same figures in one view:

| Renew programme | Appraisal days | Tolerance, per cent | Notice days for a revised offer | Decision days | Silence taken as acceptance | Dispute days | Photographs kept |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | 7 | no |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | 5 | 10 | 2 | 7 | yes | 30 | yes |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | 3 | 5 | 2 | 10 | no | 30 | yes |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | 3 | 5 | 2 | 10 | no | 30 | yes |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | 7 | 10 | 3 | 14 | yes | 30 | yes |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | 14 | 15 | 5 | 21 | yes | 45 | yes |

A device handed over in store under Renew Instant Store Quote is appraised the same day, which is why the appraisal days, the tolerance, the notice days and the decision days on that programme all stand at 0.
